text:
maria: Heads up — Cloud billing alert flagged ~12% of GPU spend in us-west1 as untagged or product=unknown. Can eng-infra do a quick ownership sweep? Invoice link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/ABC/invoices/2026-02

devon: on it. do we have a query that already narrows down untagged GPU SKUs? :eyes:

maria: I ran a quick BigQuery extract, pasted below. looks like a mix of preemptible nodepools and a couple of old batch jobs that never set labels.
```sql
SELECT project, sku_description, resource_name, labels
FROM `billing.gcp_export`
WHERE sku_description LIKE "%GPU%"
  AND (labels.team IS NULL OR labels.product = "unknown")
  AND invoice_month = "2026-02";
```

sam: that matches what I saw — our nightly CI burst into a preemptible pool in us-west1 on 2026-02-18. autoscaler created nodes without the new label-enforcer admission webhook (it flaked during the deploy).

alex: label-enforcer logs show repeated 403 when calling the org IAM role around 02:15 UTC that morning. snippet: `error=permissionDenied: serviceAccount:label-enforcer@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have resourcemanager.projects.get`

billing-bot: Alert: Unattributed GPU spend detected. Region us-west1 - 12.4% of total GPU invoice for 2026-02. Suggested action: backfill tags, re-run allocation job, notify owners.

tanvi: quick plan: 1) identify orphaned resources and backfill labels for Feb 2) re-run cost allocation with backfilled metadata 3) patch webhook deploy to retry on transient IAM errors and add retries 4) notify affected teams for FYI/chargeback.

devon: I'll assemble the list of resource names and owners. if owners are missing, propose to attribute to 'platform:infra-temp' for now and run a manual chargeback ticket. Running a query to get resource ancestry now.

maria: thanks — can we aim to have backfill and re-run by EOD tomorrow? Finance wants corrected allocation before we close the month. Also please include notes that preemptible transient pools are exempt from committed capacity chargebacks (we only bill committed pools).

sam: noted. i'll also add a short defensive check to the autoscaler: if webhook fails, create nodes with `labels.team=platform` instead of leaving blank. low-risk and makes attribution deterministic.

alex: IAM fix is small — grant `resourcemanager.projects.get` to the label-enforcer SA in the infra org. i'll patch and redeploy with a 3-retry backoff.

devon: created a temp BigQuery table `billing_unattributed_202602_backfill` and queued a backfill job. command i used: `python tools/tag_backfill.py --month 2026-02 --source bigquery --dest gcp_labels_table`

maria: perfect. please post the final list of backfilled resources in this thread once complete so finance can reconcile. tagging sweeps should also emit a comment on the invoice export. :thumbsup:

tanvi: filed INFRA-3129 to track followups: webhook retries, autoscaler fallback label, and monthly audit alert tuning. tagging sweep is a 1-off backfill for Feb, then we'll enforce moving forward.

maria: FYI — finance asked whether we should exclude preemptible/dev CI bursts from chargeback. i'll coordinate with them separately but wanted to flag it here.

devon: backfill finished — updated 47 resources, re-ran allocation, and finance export now shows unattributed GPU spend down to 0.9% for Feb. attaching brief CSV to the Jira.

maria: amazing, thanks all. we'll close the ticket after finance verifies.
